019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;

021import java.util.*;

023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
024
025/**
026 * One ribbon (toolbar) entry above a table.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * The ribbon runtime ({@code juneau-ribbon.js}) implements every behavior; this type only names it and carries its
030 * parameters.  {@link #toMap()} produces the same {@code {type, ...}} entry the runtime reads from {@code viewDef.ribbon}.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Setters are not gated per item type, but {@link #toMap()} fails loudly rather than emit a key the runtime ignores
034 * for that type (for example {@code form} on a {@code refresh}, or {@code symbol} on an {@code optionGroup}), and
035 * checks the invariants the runtime cannot: a top-level {@code option} needs {@code column} or {@code param} (exactly
036 * one) plus a {@code value}, and a group's {@code default} must name a member.  Group members take only
037 * {@code id}, {@code title}, {@code symbol}, {@code column}, {@code param} and {@code value}.
038 *
039 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
040 * <p class='bjava'>
041 *    <jv>table</jv>.ribbon(
042 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>collapseAll</jsm>(),
043 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>export</jsm>(<js>"copy"</js>, <js>"csv"</js>).optional(<js>"excel"</js>, <js>"pdf"</js>),
044 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>option</jsm>(<js>"dropped-only"</js>).title(<js>"Dropped only"</js>).column(<js>"status"</js>).value(<js>"$eq(DROPPED)"</js>).persist(<jk>true</jk>),
045 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>optionGroup</jsm>(<js>"phase"</js>,
046 *          RibbonItem.<jsm>option</jsm>(<js>"pending"</js>).column(<js>"phase"</js>).value(<js>"$in(Waiting)"</js>),
047 *          RibbonItem.<jsm>option</jsm>(<js>"done"</js>).column(<js>"phase"</js>).value(<js>"$in(Completed)"</js>)
048 *       ).defaultOption(<js>"pending"</js>),
049 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>dialog</jsm>(<js>"add"</js>).title(<js>"Add repo"</js>).form(<js>"/rest/skill-repos/add-modal"</js>)
050 *          .endpoint(<js>"/rest/skill-repos/new"</js>).method(RowAction.Method.<jsf>POST</jsf>)
051 *          .onSuccess(RowAction.OnSuccess.<jsf>REDRAW</jsf>),
052 *       RibbonItem.<jsm>refresh</jsm>());
053 *
054 *    RibbonItem.<jsm>refresh</jsm>().title(<js>"Refresh tasks"</js>).target(<js>"tasks"</js>);
055 *    RibbonItem.<jsm>publish</jsm>(<js>"Focus east"</js>, <js>"app.region-picked"</js>, Map.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"region"</js>, <js>"east"</js>));
056 * </p>
057 *
058 * @since 10.0.0
059 */
060@SuppressWarnings({
061   "java:S1192", // Repeated literals are contract wire keys; named constants would obscure the contract shape.
062   "java:S3776" // Validation and rendering chains many independent guards; splitting them adds no clarity.
063})
064public final class RibbonItem {
065
066   private static final List<String> EXPORT_BUTTONS = List.of("copy", "csv", "print", "excel", "pdf");
067   private static final List<String> EXPORT_OPTIONAL = List.of("excel", "pdf");
068   private static final List<String> APPEARANCES = List.of("icon");
069
070   // The keys juneau-ribbon.js reads for each item type (everything else is ignored there, so toMap() rejects it).
071   private static final Set<String> COMMON = Set.of("type", "id", "title", "group", "appearance", "symbol", "visibleWhen");
072   private static final Map<String,Set<String>> ALLOWED = Map.of(
073      "refresh", union(COMMON, "target"),
074      "collapseAll", union(COMMON, "target"),
075      "pausePolling", union(COMMON, "target"),
076      "resetDefaults", COMMON,
077      "dialog", union(COMMON, "form", "endpoint", "method", "onSuccess"),
078      "export", Set.of("type", "group", "appearance", "buttons", "optional", "visibleWhen"),
079      "option", union(COMMON, "column", "param", "value", "persist", "default", "target"),
080      "optionGroup", Set.of("type", "id", "title", "group", "appearance", "persist", "default", "deselectable", "options", "target", "visibleWhen"),
081      "publish", union(COMMON, "topic", "payload"),
082      "divider", Set.of("type", "visibleWhen")
083   );
084   private static final java.util.regex.Pattern CARD_ID = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$");
085   private static final Set<String> MEMBER_ALLOWED = Set.of("id", "title", "symbol", "column", "param", "value");
086
087   private final String type;
088   private String id;
089   private String title;
090   private String group;
091   private String appearance;
092   private String symbol;
093   private String form;
094   private String endpoint;
095   private String method;
096   private String onSuccess;
097   private List<String> buttons;
098   private List<String> optional;
099   private String column;
100   private String param;
101   private String value;
102   private Boolean persist;
103   private Object dflt;  // Boolean for an option, String (member id) for an optionGroup.
104   private Boolean deselectable;
105   private List<RibbonItem> options;
106   private String target;
107   private List<VisibilityRule> visibleWhen;
108   private String topic;
109   private Map<String,Object> payload;
110
111   private RibbonItem(String type) {
112      this.type = type;
113   }

164   /**
165    * The ribbon's export menu, offering the named buttons.
166    *
167    * <p>
168    * A button here is required: if its library is missing at runtime (JSZip for {@code excel}, pdfMake for
169    * {@code pdf}) it renders disabled and logs an error.  Use {@link #optional(String...)} for buttons that should
170    * simply be omitted when their library is absent.  The menu may consist of optional buttons alone, but
171    * {@link #toMap()} rejects one with no buttons at all.
172    *
173    * @param buttons The required buttons, each one of {@code copy}, {@code csv}, {@code print}, {@code excel} or
174    *    {@code pdf}.
175    * @return A new {@link RibbonItem}.
176    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code buttons} names a button not in that set.
177    */
178   public static RibbonItem export(String...buttons) {
179      for (var b : buttons)
180         checkOneOf(b, EXPORT_BUTTONS, "export button");
181      var r = new RibbonItem("export");
182      r.buttons = buttons.length == 0 ? null : List.of(buttons);
183      return r;
184   }

201   /**
202    * A server-query toggle button.
203    *
204    * <p>
205    * Set exactly one of {@link #column(String)} (a BeanQuery {@code $}-expression {@link #value(String) value}
206    * against that column) or {@link #param(String)} (a URL query parameter).  Checked by {@link #toMap()}.
207    *
208    * @param id The toggle's stable id.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
209    * @return A new {@link RibbonItem}.
210    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code id} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
211    */
212   public static RibbonItem option(String id) {
213      if (ib(id))

220   /**
221    * A group of mutually exclusive {@link #option(String) option} toggles.
222    *
223    * <p>
224    * A member may omit {@code column}/{@code param}/{@code value}; selecting it then applies no filter (an "All"
225    * member).
226    *
227    * @param id The group's stable id.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
228    * @param members The members, each created by {@link #option(String)}.  Must not be empty.
229    * @return A new {@link RibbonItem}.
230    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code id} is <jk>null</jk> or blank, or {@code members} is empty or
231    *    holds anything other than an {@code option}.
232    */
233   public static RibbonItem optionGroup(String id, RibbonItem...members) {
234      if (ib(id))
235         throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup id must not be null or blank.");
236      if (members.length == 0)
237         throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' requires at least one option.", id);
238      for (var m : members)
239         if (! "option".equals(m.type))
240            throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' member must be an option, not '%s'.", id, m.type);
241      var r = new RibbonItem("optionGroup");
242      r.id = id;
243      r.options = List.of(members);
244      return r;
245   }

247   /**
248    * A ribbon button that publishes a message when clicked.  The topic must be a custom topic declared in the
249    * page's {@code topics} or a card's {@code publishes}, or {@code cmd:<cardId>}; the console's wiring check
250    * enforces that.  Rendered only on a console page (no bus, no button).
251    *
252    * @param title The button label.
253    * @param topic The topic to publish.
254    * @param payload A JSON-serializable payload, or <jk>null</jk> for <code>{}</code>.
255    * @return A new {@link RibbonItem}.
256    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code title} or {@code topic} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
257    */
258   public static RibbonItem publish(String title, String topic, Map<String,Object> payload) {
259      if (ib(title))
260         throw iaex("RibbonItem publish requires a title.");
261      if (ib(topic))
262         throw iaex("RibbonItem publish '%s' requires a topic.", title);
263      var i = new RibbonItem("publish");
264      i.title = title;
265      i.topic = topic;
266      i.payload = payload == null ? null : new LinkedHashMap<>(payload);
267      return i;
268   }
269
270   /**
271    * Sends this item's command to another card instead of its own table.  Accepted on {@code refresh},
272    * {@code collapseAll}, {@code pausePolling}, {@code option} and {@code optionGroup}; {@link #toMap()} rejects it
273    * elsewhere.
274    *
275    * @param cardId The target card id; the console's wiring check verifies it names a card that handles the op.
276    * @return This object.
277    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code cardId} is not a valid card id.
278    */
279   public RibbonItem target(String cardId) {
280      if (cardId == null || ! CARD_ID.matcher(cardId).matches())
281         throw iaex("RibbonItem target '%s' must match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.", cardId);
282      target = cardId;
283      return this;
284   }

286   /**
287    * Hides this item unless every rule matches the console's facts.  Evaluated by the client; this only serializes the
288    * rules.  Accepted on every item type; not on an {@code optionGroup} member.
289    *
290    * @param rules The rules, ANDed together.  None clears them.
291    * @return This object.
292    */
293   public RibbonItem visibleWhen(VisibilityRule...rules) {
294      if (rules == null || Arrays.stream(rules).anyMatch(Objects::isNull))
295         throw iaex("RibbonItem visibleWhen rules must not be null.");
296      visibleWhen = rules.length == 0 ? null : List.of(rules);
297      return this;
298   }

424   /**
425    * Adds export buttons that are omitted, rather than rendered disabled, when their library is absent.
426    *

428    * @return This object.
429    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If a name is not one of those, or is already a required button.
430    */
431   public RibbonItem optional(String...names) {
432      for (var n : names) {
433         checkOneOf(n, EXPORT_OPTIONAL, "optional export button");
434         if (buttons != null && buttons.contains(n))
435            throw iaex("RibbonItem export button '%s' is both required and optional.", n);
436      }
437      optional = names.length == 0 ? null : List.of(names);
438      return this;
439   }

521   /**
522    * Builds this item's ribbon entry.
523    *
524    * @return The entry, {@code type} first, then only the keys that were set.
525    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the item sets a key the runtime ignores for its type, a top-level
526    *    {@code option} sets neither or both of {@code column} and {@code param} or no {@code value}, an
527    *    {@code export} has no buttons, or a {@code default} does not suit the item (an {@code option} takes
528    *    {@link #defaultOn()}; an {@code optionGroup} takes {@link #defaultOption(String)} naming a member), or a
529    *    {@code target} is set on a type the runtime does not route.
530    */
531   public JsonMap toMap() {
532      var m = toMap(true);
533      check(m, null);
534      return m;
535   }
536
537   private JsonMap toMap(boolean withType) {
538      var m = new JsonMap();
539      if (withType)
540         m.put("type", type);
541      if (id != null)
542         m.put("id", id);
543      if (title != null)
544         m.put("title", title);
545      if (group != null)
546         m.put("group", group);
547      if (appearance != null)
548         m.put("appearance", appearance);
549      if (symbol != null)
550         m.put("symbol", symbol);
551      if (topic != null)
552         m.put("topic", topic);
553      if (payload != null)
554         m.put("payload", payload);
555      if (target != null)
556         m.put("target", target);
557      if (form != null)
558         m.put("form", form);
559      if (endpoint != null)
560         m.put("endpoint", endpoint);
561      if (method != null)
562         m.put("method", method);
563      if (onSuccess != null)
564         m.put("onSuccess", onSuccess);
565      if (buttons != null)
566         m.put("buttons", buttons);
567      if (optional != null)
568         m.put("optional", optional);
569      if (column != null)
570         m.put("column", column);
571      if (param != null)
572         m.put("param", param);
573      if (value != null)
574         m.put("value", value);
575      if (persist != null)
576         m.put("persist", persist);
577      if (dflt != null)
578         m.put("default", dflt);
579      if (deselectable != null)
580         m.put("deselectable", deselectable);
581      if (visibleWhen != null)
582         m.put("visibleWhen", VisibilityRule.toMaps(visibleWhen));
583      if (options != null) {
584         m.put("options", new JsonList(options.stream().map(o -> o.toMap(false)).toList()));
585      }
586      return m;
587   }
588
589   /**
590    * Validates an authored ribbon item map (for example from a JSON5 card body) with exactly the rules
591    * {@link #toMap()} applies to a built item: a known {@code type}, only keys the runtime reads, an
592    * {@code export} with at least one valid button, an {@code option} with exactly one of {@code column} or
593    * {@code param} plus a {@code value}, a {@code default} that suits the item, a valid {@code appearance} and
594    * {@code target}, a well-formed {@code visibleWhen} (a list of {@code field}/{@code op} rules with a known op), and the same rules for each {@code optionGroup} member.
595    *
596    * @param item The authored item.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
597    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the item is not valid.
598    */
599   public static void validate(Map<?,?> item) {
600      check(item, null);
601   }
602
603   // The one rule set behind toMap() and validate().  parentId is non-null only for an optionGroup member (a map with no 'type').
604   private static void check(Map<?,?> m, String parentId) {
605      var isMember = parentId != null;
606      var t = m.get("type");
607      var declaredType = t instanceof String ts ? ts : null;
608      var type = isMember ? "option" : declaredType;
609      if (! isMember && (type == null || ! ALLOWED.containsKey(type))) {
610         if (t == null)
611            throw iaex("RibbonItem requires a 'type'; one of '%s'.", String.join(", ", new TreeSet<>(ALLOWED.keySet())));
612         if (! (t instanceof String))
613            throw iaex("RibbonItem 'type' must be a string, not '%s'; one of '%s'.", t, String.join(", ", new TreeSet<>(ALLOWED.keySet())));
614         throw iaex("RibbonItem type '%s' is not one of '%s'.", t, String.join(", ", new TreeSet<>(ALLOWED.keySet())));
615      }
616      var id = m.get("id");
617      if (! isMember) {
618         if ("export".equals(type)) {
619            if (m.get("buttons") == null && m.get("optional") == null)
620               throw iaex("RibbonItem export requires at least one button.");
621            checkAll(m.get("buttons"), EXPORT_BUTTONS, "export button");
622            checkAll(m.get("optional"), EXPORT_OPTIONAL, "optional export button");
623         }
624         if (m.get("appearance") != null)
625            checkOneOf(String.valueOf(m.get("appearance")), APPEARANCES, "appearance");
626         if (m.get("target") != null && ! (m.get("target") instanceof String ts && CARD_ID.matcher(ts).matches()))
627            throw iaex("RibbonItem target '%s' must match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.", m.get("target"));
628      }
629      if (isMember || "option".equals(type))
630         checkScope(m, id, ! isMember);
631      if (! isMember && m.get("default") != null)
632         checkDefault(m, type, id);
633      if (! isMember && m.get("visibleWhen") != null)
634         checkVisibleWhen(m.get("visibleWhen"), type, id);
635      if ("optionGroup".equals(type) && m.get("options") != null) {
636         if (! (m.get("options") instanceof List<?> members))
637            throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' options must be a list.", id);
638         for (var o : members) {
639            if (! (o instanceof Map<?,?> mm))
640               throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' each option must be an object.", id);
641            check(mm, String.valueOf(id));
642         }
643      }
644      var allowed = isMember ? MEMBER_ALLOWED : ALLOWED.get(type);
645      for (var k : m.keySet())
646         if (! allowed.contains(String.valueOf(k))) {
647            if (isMember)
648               throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' member '%s' does not accept '%s'.", parentId, id, k);
649            throw iaex("RibbonItem %s%s does not accept '%s'.", type, id == null ? "" : " '" + id + "'", k);
650         }
651   }
652
653   private static void checkVisibleWhen(Object v, String type, Object id) {
654      var ok = v instanceof List<?> l && l.stream().allMatch(r -> r instanceof Map<?,?> rm
655         && rm.get("field") instanceof String f && ! f.isBlank()
656         && rm.get("op") instanceof String op && VisibilityRule.KNOWN_OPS.contains(op));
657      if (! ok)
658         throw iaex("RibbonItem %s%s visibleWhen must be a list of {field, op[, value]} rules with a known op.", type, id == null ? "" : " '" + id + "'");
659   }
660
661   private static void checkAll(Object v, List<String> allowed, String what) {
662      if (v == null)
663         return;
664      if (! (v instanceof List<?> l))
665         throw iaex("RibbonItem %s list must be a list.", what);
666      for (var b : l)
667         checkOneOf(String.valueOf(b), allowed, what);
668   }
669
670   private static void checkScope(Map<?,?> m, Object id, boolean topLevel) {
671      var column = m.get("column");
672      var param = m.get("param");
673      if (column != null && param != null)
674         throw iaex("RibbonItem option '%s' sets both column '%s' and param '%s'.", id, column, param);
675      if (topLevel && column == null && param == null)
676         throw iaex("RibbonItem option '%s' sets neither column nor param.", id);
677      if (topLevel && m.get("value") == null)
678         throw iaex("RibbonItem option '%s' requires a value.", id);
679   }
680
681   private static void checkDefault(Map<?,?> m, String type, Object id) {
682      var d = m.get("default");
683      if ("optionGroup".equals(type)) {
684         var ok = d instanceof String && m.get("options") instanceof List<?> l
685            && l.stream().anyMatch(o -> o instanceof Map<?,?> mm && d.equals(mm.get("id")));
686         if (! ok)
687            throw iaex("RibbonItem optionGroup '%s' default '%s' is not one of its options.", id, d);
688      } else if ("option".equals(type) && ! Boolean.TRUE.equals(d)) {
689         throw iaex("RibbonItem option '%s' default '%s' must be on; use defaultOn().", id, d);
690      }
691   }
692
693   private static Set<String> union(Set<String> base, String...more) {
694      var s = new LinkedHashSet<>(base);
695      s.addAll(Arrays.asList(more));
696      return Set.copyOf(s);
697   }
698
699   private static void checkOneOf(String v, List<String> allowed, String what) {
700      if (! allowed.contains(v))
701         throw iaex("RibbonItem %s '%s' is not one of '%s'.", what, v, String.join(", ", allowed));
702   }
703}
